STM32U0.basis: Direct ST eStore RAM and Supply Voltage observations for U031/U073/U083.

STM32L5.basis: Direct ST eStore RAM and Supply Voltage observations for L552/L562.

STM32U3.basis: Direct ST eStore RAM and Supply Voltage observations for U375/U385/U3B5/U3C5.

STM32WL3.basis: Direct ST eStore density-scoped RAM and Supply Voltage observations.

STM32WLX.basis: Direct ST eStore density-scoped RAM and Supply Voltage observations.

STM32H7RS.basis: Direct ST eStore exact product title RAM and Supply Voltage observations for H7R3/H7R7/H7S3/H7S7.

STM32N6.basis: Direct ST eStore exact product title 4.2 MB SRAM and Supply Voltage observations; manufacturer unit preserved without conversion.

STM32F0.finding: ST Product Selector exposes RAM Size and Supply Voltage per base-device row. Full exact-family admission requires deterministic extraction/join of those rows; series/density inference is not allowed.
STM32F0.next_evidence_needed: Retained Product Selector base-row snapshot or supported official structured endpoint covering every Production base device.

STM32F3.finding: Product Selector directly exposes RAM and Supply Voltage, but subseries have materially different voltage ranges and memory compositions. Current retained observations do not cover every Production base row.
STM32F3.next_evidence_needed: Complete Product Selector base-row extraction for all Production F3 base devices.

STM32F4.finding: Product Selector shows same series/density can have different Supply Voltage minima by base/package variant, so series+density grouping is unsafe.
STM32F4.next_evidence_needed: Complete retained Product Selector row map for all Production F4 base devices.

STM32F7.finding: Product Selector provides RAM and Supply Voltage columns, but full Production base-row mapping has not been retained. No family-level inference is permitted.
STM32F7.next_evidence_needed: Complete Product Selector base-row extraction for all Production F7 base devices.

STM32C5.finding: eStore/Product Selector observations include C5A3 RAM wording inconsistency and the full base-row map is not yet retained.
STM32C5.next_evidence_needed: Resolve C5A3 RAM from Product Selector row evidence and retain complete C5 base-row RAM/VDD map.

STM32L0.finding: Legacy L0 variants require exact Product Selector RAM/VDD row mapping; current evidence is not complete enough for whole-family binding.
STM32L0.next_evidence_needed: Complete Product Selector base-row extraction for all Production L0 base devices.

STM32L4.finding: Product Selector exposes RAM and Supply Voltage, but L4/L4+ contains multiple RAM/VDD configurations. Full Production base-row mapping is required.
STM32L4.next_evidence_needed: Complete Product Selector base-row extraction for all Production L4 base devices, including L4+.

STM32L1.finding: eStore confirms voltage range but available series descriptions use 'up to' RAM wording; density-specific exact RAM is not fully established for all Production rows.
STM32L1.next_evidence_needed: Retained Product Selector density/base rows with exact RAM for all Production L1 devices.

STM32U5.finding: Official U5 observations use conflicting RAM representations for graphics subseries (marketing MB wording versus technical KiB values). Normalization without a locked Product Selector row policy would invent semantics.
STM32U5.next_evidence_needed: Product Selector row snapshot defining authoritative RAM value/unit for every U5 base device.

STM32H7.finding: ST eStore H7 catalog contains multiple Supply Voltage minima and materially different SRAM configurations. Whole-family series-level reuse is unsafe.
STM32H7.next_evidence_needed: Complete exact/base-level Product Selector/eStore RAM and Supply Voltage map for Production H7.

STM32WBA2X.finding: The same official eStore product can show Supply Voltage Min parameter 1.8 V while descriptive operating-condition text states 1.71–3.6 V. Selecting one without an explicit source policy would be arbitrary.
STM32WBA2X.next_evidence_needed: Product Selector row or ST clarification establishing which allowed-source field owns Operating VDD.

STM32WBX.finding: Several WB series have direct RAM values, but WB55 density variants are represented with 'up to 256 Kbytes SRAM' in available eStore descriptions; exact RAM per Production density is not completely established.
STM32WBX.next_evidence_needed: Product Selector rows or exact eStore evidence for WB55 256/512/640/1024-KiB Flash variants.

STM32WBA5X.finding: WBA50 has direct 64-KiB SRAM evidence and 1-MiB WBA52/54/55/WBA5M examples show 128 KiB, but some 512-KiB Flash variants expose only 'up to 128 Kbytes SRAM' wording.
STM32WBA5X.next_evidence_needed: Exact Product Selector/eStore RAM rows for every 512-KiB Production WBA5X base device.

STM32WBA6X.finding: eStore Supply Voltage is available, but retained exact SRAM evidence is not complete across WBA62/63/64/65 Production variants.
STM32WBA6X.next_evidence_needed: Complete exact Product Selector/eStore RAM map for all WBA6X Production base devices.

STM32H5.finding: eStore generic Supply Voltage may report 1.62 V while application VDD semantics observed elsewhere are 1.71 V-class. Treating generic supply as Operating VDD would risk semantic mislabeling.
STM32H5.next_evidence_needed: Allowed-source Product Selector row evidence explicitly defining the Operating VDD field for all H5 base devices.

STM32WB0.finding: Production WB0 includes network-coprocessor identities with nonstandard Flash/RAM semantics alongside MCU variants. A single current Basic Profile RAM/Flash interpretation would overstate device-local memory.
STM32WB0.next_evidence_needed: Role-aware Product Selector/eStore memory contract for WB0 MCU versus network-coprocessor variants.
